Ancient Claim: 主风寒咳逆邪气，温中，金疮，破症瘕积聚，堕胎，为回阳救逆第一品。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ fēnghán kénì xiéqì, wēnzhōng, jīnchuāng, pò zhèngjiǎ, wéi huíyáng jiùnì dìyī pǐn.
English Translation: Premier medicine for rescuing devastated Yang and restoring collapsed pulse; drives out deep cold from bones and joints.
Western Indication: Heart Failure, Circulatory Shock & Severe Arthralgia (ICD-11: BD10)
Mechanism: Voltage-gated sodium channel site-2 gating modifier and cardiac pacemaker stimulation

Ancient Claim: 下瘀血，血闭寒热，破症瘕积聚，留饮宿食，荡涤肠胃，推陈致新。
Claim Transliteration: Xià yūxuè, xuèbì hánrè, pò zhèngjiǎ jījù, liúyǐn sùshí, dàngdí chángwèi, tuīchén zhìxīn.
English Translation: Purges blood stasis and hard abdominal masses, cleanses the stomach and intestines of stale food, and drives out the old to establish the new.
Mechanism: Stimulation of bowel peristalsis and competitive ATP-binding site kinase modulation

Classical Source: Kaibao Bencao (Materia Medica of the Kaibao Era)
Ancient Claim: 主瘰疬，消痈肿，疗头面风疮，五痔，止心痛，益血气，黑髭发，悦颜色。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ luǒlì, xiāo yōngzhǒng, liáo tóumiàn fēngchuāng, yì xuèqì, hēi zīfà.
English Translation: Tonifies liver and kidneys, nourishes blood and essence, blackens the hair, and prolongs lifespan.
Mechanism: Inhibition of hepatic cholesterol biosynthesis and upregulation of Nrf2 antioxidant enzymes

Ancient Claim: 主伤寒热病，咽喉痹痛，消痞块，痈疽，引诸药行经络。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ shānghán rèbìng, yānhóu bìtòng, xiāo pǐkuài, yōngjū.
English Translation: Unblocks stubborn meridian obstruction, relieves intractable arthralgia, and disperses hardened inflammatory masses.
Mechanism: Potent spinal glycine receptor competitive modulation and descending pain pathway suppression

Ancient Claim: 青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之，治寒热诸疟。
Claim Transliteration: Qīnghāo yī wò, yǐ shuǐ èr shēng zì, jiǎo qǔ zhī, jìn fú zhī, zhì hánrè zhū nüè.
English Translation: Take a handful of Qinghao, soak in two liters of water, wring out the juice, and ingest to purge chills, fevers, and intermittent malaria.
Mechanism: Endoperoxide free radical cleavage and catalytic protease inhibition

Ancient Claim: 主诸热黄疸，肠澼泄痢，逐水，下血闭，恶疮疽蚀火疡。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ zhū rè huángdǎn, chángpì xièlì, zhú shuǐ, xià xuèbì, èchuāng jùshí huǒyáng.
English Translation: Clears all heat jaundice, dysentery and bowel flux, dispels fluid retention, and resolves severe inflammatory carbuncles.
Western Indication: Inflammatory Bowel Disease & Acute Hepatitis (ICD-11: DB30)
Mechanism: Selective inhibition of prostaglandin endoperoxide synthase and inflammatory cytokine suppression

Ancient Claim: 主热气目痛，眦伤泣出，明目，肠澼泄痢，妇人阴蚀疽痔。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ rèqì mùtòng, zìshāng qìchū, míngmù, chángpì xièlì, fùrén yīnshí jùzhì.
English Translation: Treats heat conjunctivitis and eye pain, cures infectious diarrhea and dysentery, and resolves festering ulcerations.
Mechanism: AMPK pathway activation and competitive inhibition of cholesterol synthesis catalytic domain

Ancient Claim: 主心腹邪气，肠鸣幽幽如走水，寒热积聚，破宿血，生新血。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ xīnfù xiéqì, chángmíng yōuyōu rú zǒushuǐ, hánrè jījù, pò sùxuè, shēng xīnxuè.
English Translation: Dispels stagnant pathogenic qi from heart and abdomen, breaks up ancient blood stasis, and promotes microvascular blood regeneration.
Western Indication: Coronary Artery Disease & Myocardial Infarction (ICD-11: BA80)
Mechanism: Tyrosine kinase receptor binding inhibition and coronary vasodilation

Ancient Claim: 主补五脏，安精神，定魂魄，止惊悸，除邪气，明目，开心益智。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ bǔ wǔzàng, ān jīngshén, dìng húnpò, zhǐ jīngjì, chú xiéqì, míngmù, kāixīn yìzhì.
English Translation: Tonifies the five internal organs, stabilizes spirit and soul, stops palpitations from shock, clears eyes, and enhances cognitive intellect.
Mechanism: Nuclear receptor modulation and central cholinergic neuroprotection

Ancient Claim: 主心腹结积，疰忤，下气，破血，痈肿，通月经。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ xīnfù jiéjī, zhùwǔ, xiàqì, pòxuè, yōngzhǒng, tōng yuèjīng.
English Translation: Breaks blood stasis, dispels abdominal masses, reduces swollen carbuncles, and regulates amenorrhea.
Mechanism: Dual suppression of NF-kB activation and ATP-competitive kinase inhibition

Ancient Claim: 主五脏六腑寒热邪气，坚筋骨，长肌肉，倍力，金疮肿，解毒。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ wǔzàng liùfǔ hánrè xiéqì, jiān jīngǔ, zhǎng jīròu, bèi lì, jīnchuāng zhǒng, jiědú.
English Translation: Harmonizes the visceral systems, strengthens sinews and bones, heals traumatic wounds, and neutralizes all hundred toxins.
Mechanism: Inhibition of 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase and mucosal cytoprotection

Ancient Claim: 主痈疽久败疮，排脓止痛，大风癞疾，五痔鼠瘘，补虚，小儿百病。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ yōngjū jiǔ bàichuāng, pái nóng zhǐ tòng, dàfēng làijí, wǔzhì shǔlòu, bǔ xū.
English Translation: Treats chronic non-healing carbuncles and ulcers, expels pus, stops pain, tonifies fundamental qi deficiency, and builds vigor.
Mechanism: Inhibition of extracellular matrix degradation and telomerase activation

Ancient Claim: 主消渴，身大热，呕吐，诸痹，起阴气，解诸毒。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ xiāokě, shēn dàrè, ǒutù, zhūbì, qǐ yīnqì, jiě zhū dú.
English Translation: Treats wasting-thirst diabetes, intense body heat, neck stiffness, alleviates vomiting, and neutralizes alcohol intoxication.
Mechanism: Aldose reductase inhibition preventing polyol pathway osmotic cell damage

Ancient Claim: 主痈疽发背，一切恶疮，散热解毒，消痈散结。
Claim Transliteration: Zhǔ yōngjū fābèi, yīqiè èchuāng, sànrè jiědú, xiāoyōng sànjié.
English Translation: Treats deep toxic back carbuncles, dispels heat toxins, and resolves inflammatory swelling nodulations.
Western Indication: Upper Respiratory Tract Infection & Pharyngitis (ICD-11: CA02)
Mechanism: Blockade of spike protein binding interface and broad spectrum antiviral action
